explore-quarter.title: Cut a quarter-wave vertical
explore-quarter.prompt: Set the length so it resonates on 21.125 MHz.

explore-radials.title: Match the ground plane
explore-radials.prompt: Change the radials to bring the feed impedance to 50 Ω.
explore-radials.success: Sloping the radials down raises the feed impedance from about 36 Ω to 50 Ω.

explore-coil.title: An 80 m mobile whip
explore-coil.prompt: Add loading-coil inductance until the whip resonates on 3.75 MHz.
hints: You need about 1500 Ω of inductive reactance: around 64 µH.
explore-coil.success: About 64 µH cancels the whip's −1500 Ω. The coil makes the short whip resonate.
